name: Retro console
one_line: A mid-90s 3D console: low resolution, few colour steps, dither, wobbling corners.

rows.help: How many pixel rows tall the picture is (240 is the classic).
rows.label: Rows

levels.help: Steps per colour channel. Fewer = more banding and dither.
levels.label: Colour steps

wobble.help: Corners snap to the pixel grid, so shapes jitter as they move.
wobble.label: Wobble

measured.how: hidden Chromium on the kit's test laptop, whole frame read back from the graphics chip; machine load changes it
